versionNote: Includes initial versions and saved revisions across SKILL, MCP, HOOK and other types. Deleted capabilities retain historical revisions; deletion itself is excluded.
failed: Delivery data could not be calculated. Please try again later.
stale: Refresh failed. Showing the last available report.
historicalStatusWarning: Some historical statuses cannot be classified; totals may be incomplete. Historical statuses use the current workflow template.
autonomousUnique: Covers {{value}} distinct requirements; completing a reopened requirement counts as another delivery.
partialNote: Dimmed bars/points mark a partial week (truncated window start, or the current week is still running); hover a bucket for the full range and the reason.
tooltipPartialStart: This bucket is truncated by the window start and is not a full week
tooltipPartialEnd: The current week is incomplete; do not compare with full weeks
tooltipObserving: {{value}} more requirements are still within their 7-day window
offtime: Requirements running outside working hours (nights, weekends and holidays)
durationCaliber: Caliber: counts delivery rounds that started within the selected period, attributed by start time — the same caliber as the chart; only completed rounds are counted, so rounds started but not yet finished are excluded, and rounds with no start evidence are also excluded from the mean. Duration = elapsed time from the round's first start (agent assignment / task acceptance / entering in-progress) to the status change into Done, including waiting, nights and weekends. The headline is the sample-weighted mean across weekly buckets. Weekly delivery throughput, new-requirement 7-day resolution, human involvement count and autonomous deliveries still use the completion caliber.
